selection.ownership: Bloomerang, Indianapolis, Indiana, United States (9120 Otis Avenue). International donor CRM REST API v2 at api.bloomerang.co; not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Bloomerang REST API (private X-API-KEY server-to-server keys, current v2 vs v1), help-center API Keys 2.0 generation, pinned GET /constituents, GET /constituents/search, GET /constituent/{id}, Indianapolis operator identity, and dated incident search (Bloomerang + security breach/incident). October 2025 hosting-provider outage and April 2026 Cloudflare regional access issue are availability events, not customer-data compromises. No qualifying current unresolved Bloomerang API/customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Bloomerang REST API is a private-key server-to-server API. Help-center API Keys 2.0 are generated from Profile > My Profile. Pinned v2 host is https://api.bloomerang.co/v2 with X-API-KEY. Constituent list/search/get are cheap authenticated CRM reads of the caller's own database. Operator is Bloomerang, Indianapolis, Indiana, United States. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found hosting/Cloudflare availability incidents, not a qualifying unresolved data compromise.

incidents.finding: Official Bloomerang status described a resolved ~22-hour hosting-provider performance incident affecting Fundraising email and CRM mobile. Availability event; no customer-data compromise claimed.
incidents.limitation: Historical availability incident. This is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Official status attributed a regional login/access issue to a Cloudflare incident in south-central US states. Availability/connectivity event; no customer-data compromise claimed.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /constituents?take=1 (cheap authenticated list). Pinned validator GET /user/current is not a pinned upstream action and is not fabricated.
Native category is crm (donor CRM). Source Productivity is valid but less precise.

Returns raw Bloomerang JSON under data. Optional skip (>=0), take (1-50), type, orderBy, and orderDirection use pinned query names. Pipe-joined ids, lastModified, isFavorite, and customFieldId/customFieldValue filters are omitted because native templates cannot express the source join/pair encoding.
Maps to pinned GET /constituents/search with required search text and optional skip/take/type. This is an in-account CRM text search, not a billed enrichment lookup.
constituentId is a required positive integer path segment on GET /constituent/{constituentId}. Returns raw Bloomerang JSON under data rather than the upstream {constituent} wrapper.
Maps to POST /constituent. Returns raw Bloomerang JSON under data.
Maps to POST /transactions with AccountId, Date, and Designations.
